name: Mummy Pharaoh
languages: plus any two languages they knew while alive

items.name: Longspear
items.description: This very long spear, sometimes called a pike, is purely for thrusting rather than throwing. Used by many soldiers and city watch for crowd control and defense against charging enemies, it must be wielded with two hands.

savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. vitality

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike (Special)
defensiveAbilities.description:
The mummy pharaoh can use Reactive Strike when a creature within its reach uses a concentrate action, in addition to its normal trigger. It can disrupt triggering concentrate actions, and it disrupts actions on any hit, not just a critical hit.

See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Rejuvenation
defensiveAbilities.description: When a mummy pharaoh is destroyed, necromantic energies rebuild its body in its tomb over 1d10 days. If the body is destroyed during that time, the process starts anew. A reforming mummy pharaoh is destroyed permanently if their tomb is consecrated.

defensiveAbilities.name: Sacred Wrappings
defensiveAbilities.description:
When a creature deals physical damage to the pharaoh or triggers one of the pharaoh's weaknesses, it must succeed at a DC 28 Will Saving Throw save or become Doomed 1.

Regardless of the results of the save, the creature is then immune to that mummy's sacred wrappings for 24 hours.

defensiveAbilities.name: Undead Mastery
defensiveAbilities.description:
100 feet.

Commanded or allied undead in the aura that have a lower level than the mummy pharaoh gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, AC, saves, and skill checks.

Effect: Undead Mastery

offensiveAbilities.name: Sandstorm Wrath
offensiveAbilities.description:
The mummy pharaoh exhales a 60ft Cone of superheated sand that deals 5d6 Fire Damage|options:area-damage]{5d6 fire damage and 5d6 slashing damage} (Basic DC 28 Reflex Saving Throw save).

The mummy pharaoh can't use Sandstorm Wrath again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Veil of Sand
offensiveAbilities.description:
Sand whirls around the mummy pharaoh in a 5-foot emanation until the beginning of their next turn. Creatures inside the sand are Concealed to those outside it and any living creature ending its turn within the sand takes 4d6 Slashing Damage damage with a Basic DC 28 Fortitude Saving Throw save

Veil of Sand ends if the mummy takes damage from their water weakness.
